# Root (creature)

Internal ID: TentaRoot | Type: Minion | Faction: Boss | Main biome: Black Forest | Abilities: Attack (3s) | Weak to (x1.5): Fire | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Lightning, ,, Spirit | Resistant to (x0.5): Frost | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Stagger, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe

# Introduction

Roots are aggressive creatures spawned by The Elder. They are enlarged, vicious tree roots that flail around frantically in an attempt to damage their target.

## Spawning

• Type: From the spawn ability of The Elder | Limit: ? | Frequency: - | Stars: No

### Attack

Every 3 seconds when a player is within 4 meters, a Root can slam down on the player (55 Blunt, 20 Tier 0 Chop and 20 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). This hits in a 4-meter 90-degree vertical arc.

## Notes

• They will appear on the highest area, including on player built structures. For example, if a building with 3 floors is built, roots will only spawn on the roof rather than on the first and second floors until the roof is destroyed.

Categorias: Minions
